Rules.ActionsHint: Each round you can perform one full action and one quick action, or two quick actions.

FullNotes.FullCover: Ranged attacks against you get –3 dice and must penetrate the barrier. You cannot dodge. Cluttered zones only.

QuickNotes.PartialCover: Ranged attacks against you get –2 dice. You can still dodge. Cluttered zones only.
QuickNotes.Defend: Declare before the attacker rolls. Each success you roll cancels one of the attacker's.
QuickNotes.Aim: +2 dice to the attack. Short range or more, on your turn immediately before the attack.
QuickNotes.Dodge: Declare before the attacker rolls. Each success you roll cancels one of the attacker's. Not possible in full cover.
QuickNotes.Rally: On a success they are no longer broken and recover 1 Health per success.

Quick.MoveRange: Move between Short and Adjacent range
Quick.MoveDoor: Move to a door or hatch and peek through
Quick.Defend: Defend against a close combat attack
Quick.PickUp: Pick up an item from the ground

ALTSHEET.EditModeOn: Editing: attributes, skill ranks, name and career are unlocked. Click to lock.
ALTSHEET.EditModeOff: Locked for play. Click to edit attributes, skill ranks, name and career.
ALTSHEET.Limited: You only have limited access to this character.
ALTSHEET.CareerDrop: Drag a Career or Specialty item here
ALTSHEET.CareerLegacy: Set on the system's sheet. Drag a Career item here to replace it.
ALTSHEET.RollHint: Click a button to roll. Shift-click, right-click or the slider button to add modifiers first.
ALTSHEET.NoWeapons: No weapons equipped. Equip one on the Gear tab.
ALTSHEET.NoType: Set a weapon type (ranged or melee) on the item to roll it.
ALTSHEET.NoTalents: No talents yet. Drag one here from a compendium.
ALTSHEET.StateLegend: Equipped items count for armor, supplies and bonuses. Carried items only add weight. Stowed items are in your foot locker and weigh nothing.

State.EquippedTip: Equipped: counts for armor, supplies and bonuses
State.CarriedTip: Carried: in your pack, adds weight only
State.StoredTip: Stowed in your foot locker: no weight

ALTSHEET.NoItems: Nothing here. Drag items in from a compendium or the Items sidebar.
